address: Leylaty, Al Malik Road, Al Khalidiyyah, Jeddah, 23422, Saudi Arabia
bio: Nikkei cuisine comes to life in Jeddah’s upscale Leylati space – an event space-cum-restaurant hub. Hidden away on the side of the domed building is this atmospheric restaurant with an eye-catching mocktail bar. Sit at the large wooden counter, which fringes the open kitchen, to watch the sushi chefs show off their Japanese techniques. From crunchy shrimps to Wagyu sliders, there’s something for everyone – and sharing is recommended!
